moments.action: Night street outside a lit shopfront: a suited man hauls himself out of a parked car, a young man in a leather jacket turns toward it, a low angle catches the wheel, then the frame drops into a dark doorway inside.

Inside the smoky den players hunch over a green gambling table; the camera pushes past dark bodies into a cluttered back room where a bald man in a suit now stands holding a black folder, crew gathered round him.

An older man in a white suit and panama hat appears in the yellow corridor; the young man in the black shirt looks up, and by the last shot Kamata has stepped into the back room greeted as the uncle he was about to visit.

Kamata asks if he has been well and the younger man grins yes; the talk turns to business as he leans over the desk and hands across last week's take, Kamata standing over him while the crew hangs back.
The younger man straightens, then puts an open palm out toward the leather armchair; by the wide shot Kamata has turned his back on him and is walking to the seat he has been offered.

Kamata settles into the armchair and fixes him with a stare; the younger man drops his eyes, and the wide finds the old man at the desk with a ledger open, working through the books while the other stands waiting.

Going through the printouts, Kamata admits he doesn't understand half of what he is looking at; the younger man laughs it off as more complicated than it is, and the smile dies as the old man just sits silent.
The question lands - whether his partner is stealing from them. The younger man holds Kamata's look across the desk, then in the last shot his eyes drop to the floor and the easy grin is gone.
